Character_Buster.description: Small young adult companion dog, compact toy-to-small terrier mix build, short smooth black-and-white coat with irregular patches, floppy dark ears, bright dark round eyes, black nose, pink-black tongue often visible, expressive posture; bare-fur default daytime look.
Character_Buster.voice_profile: Non-speaking animal; only natural small-dog sounds—happy pants, collar jingles, soft whines, sleepy sighs—light, quick, playful energy, never human words.
Character_Buster.visual_lock: Always the same small black-and-white short-coated dog: shape, floppy ears, bright dark eyes, patchy black-and-white markings that never recolor. Default continuity portrait is bare-fur short coat. Never redraw as a large breed, long-haired dog, or solid single color.
wardrobe_always: snug black-and-white dog pajama top and bottoms for bedtime/stairs/bed/dream chase beats — not base portrait
Character_Buster.performance_notes: Silent comic lead; reacts with head tilts, freezes, spins, and full-body leaps; eyes on Mom, treats, and yard action—never addresses camera as a confessor.

Character_Mom.description: Human woman in her late 30s to mid 40s, medium build, warm medium skin, shoulder-length brown hair loosely tucked behind ears, soft open face with kind brown eyes and gentle smile lines; contemporary suburban-casual home wear—soft knit top in muted rose or cream, comfortable home pants, indoor shoes or socks.
Character_Mom.voice_profile: Adult female, warm mid pitch, gentle but clear diction, calm pace that sharpens kindly on corrections (“Uh-uh,” “It’s time for bed”); steady nurturing energy every scene.
Character_Mom.visual_lock: Same adult woman each scene: shoulder-length brown hair, kind brown eyes, medium build, soft knit home clothes in muted warm tones. Distinct as the only adult woman on screen; never swap hair color, age band, or silhouette with Daddy.
wardrobe_always: soft knit evening top in muted rose or cream
Character_Mom.performance_notes: Speaks only to Buster and household business; firm-kind eye contact with the dog; no direct address to camera.

Character_Daddy.description: Human man in his late 30s to mid 40s, medium-tall build, fair-to-medium skin, short brown hair lightly greying at the temples, clean-shaven or very light stubble, tired eyes; simple soft pajama shirt as default home look.
Character_Daddy.voice_profile: No dialogue in this adaptation; presence only—occasional soft page-turn or mattress shift, low quiet room energy.
Character_Daddy.visual_lock: Same adult man each appearance: short brown hair with light temple grey, medium-tall build, soft simple pajama shirt. Only adult man on screen; face and hair must not drift toward Mom's features or a second generic parent.
wardrobe_always: soft simple pajama shirt for bed reading
Character_Daddy.performance_notes: Silent on-screen; reads in bed, shares the mattress space when Buster lands; looks at book or family, not camera.

Character_Narrator.description: Pure off-screen verse narrator; no on-camera body.
Character_Narrator.voice_profile: Warm adult storyteller, medium pitch, clear rhyming cadence, playful affection without baby-talk; steady gentle energy and identical timbre every cue.
Character_Narrator.performance_notes: Voice-over only; never appears on camera; reads the book’s refrain and story beats over picture-book action.
